scope_gaps.note: No cited snapshot recommends observing one's own last-caffeine time and sleep; the row is backed only as far as it rests on the source facts that timing before bedtime matters (NHS 6 h, Gardiner 8.8 h).

The NHS line groups tea and coffee with smoking and alcohol and gives no evidence basis or dose for the 6 h figure; it is page guidance for people with sleep problems, not a measured result. It names tea and coffee only, not other caffeine sources. The stored text is the main region (4304 of 4844 chars).

Only the abstract is stored. The 8.8 h applies to coffee at 107 mg per 250 mL and to the outcome 'avoid reductions in total sleep time', not to other sleep measures or other doses. The abstract does not describe how 8.8 h was derived or give its uncertainty.

The abstract says the guidance comes from the results of the meta-analysis of 24 studies. It does not describe how the 8.8 h threshold was derived from the pooled data, so the exact method could not be checked from the abstract.

The abstract gives 45 min as an overall result without dose, timing, comparator or confidence interval; the sentence says 'w wyniku zbiorczym' but a reader might read it as applying at any dose or time of day.
The source says 'at least' 8.8 h and 13.2 h (minimum intervals to avoid a reduction in total sleep time); the sentence drops 'co najmniej', so a reader might take the figures as exact intervals.
The grade A is editorial and was not checked. The abstract gives no design of the included studies, risk of bias, certainty or heterogeneity, so the grade cannot be assessed from the stored abstract.

The 6 h figure is the NHS advice for tea or coffee (with smoking and alcohol), not a separate caffeine source; coffee appears under both the NHS 6 h and the Gardiner 8.8 h. The sentence does not say which figure belongs to which source, and a reader might assume three distinct caffeine sources.
The abstract ties the 8.8 h and 13.2 h to these specific doses (107 mg per 250 mL and 217.5 mg) rather than presenting them as illustrative examples; it does not say whether other doses scale.
